title: Keeping the River Clean
text:
In the small town of Harwick, residents noticed that the river running through the park had turned brown after a factory upstream closed. Local families stopped fishing there, and children were warned to stay away from the water. Worried about their health and their favourite place to walk, a group of neighbours decided to act together. They formed a volunteer committee and began collecting water samples every month.

The committee asked the city council for permission to hold public meetings. At the first meeting, more than two hundred people attended, and many offered to help with cleaning days. Within a year, the volunteers had removed tons of rubbish from the banks and persuaded the factory's new owners to install a filter. Today the river is clearer, and fish have returned to its waters.

options: It had become too deep to cross
It had been covered with ice

What can be inferred about the factory's new owners?
options: They were unwilling to help the community at all
They agreed to reduce pollution after pressure from the community

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the community's attitude?
options: They were indifferent to the condition of the river
They were willing to work together to solve a shared problem
They preferred to leave the problem to the government
They wanted to move away from the town

paragraph_translations: En el pequeño pueblo de Harwick, los habitantes notaron que el río que atravesaba el parque se había vuelto marrón después de que cerrara una fábrica río arriba. Las familias locales dejaron de pescar allí y a los niños se les advirtió que se mantuvieran alejados del agua. Preocupados por su salud y por su lugar favorito para caminar, un grupo de vecinos decidió actuar juntos. Formaron un comité de voluntarios y comenzaron a recoger muestras de agua cada mes.

El comité pidió al ayuntamiento permiso para celebrar reuniones públicas. En la primera reunión asistieron más de doscientas personas, y muchas se ofrecieron a participar en los días de limpieza. En menos de un año, los voluntarios habían retirado toneladas de basura de las orillas y habían convencido a los nuevos propietarios de la fábrica para instalar un filtro. Hoy el río está más limpio y los peces han regresado a sus aguas.
